notes.title: Patch #0.2.2.6
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164465/7765b64302b75240ffa7c84fedd94360c1a09080.png


 Overview: 


This time we are coming up with a major change done to your starting items. We implemented 2 new items (D.I.O.S. & STYX). D.I.O.S. is you new Console and replaces your former workbench. STYX is your new basic tool and replaces the former axe AND torch. You will see a first glimpse on where MetaTron is heading towards in the future.

The second part we concentrated on was balancing. See the section below for more details:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164465/edf374bd8170c82008ba5471e4ad8a0e19e9ab70.png


STYX: 

Your new basic survival tool. Made out of polyphibranium and ceramic. STYX will be the new multitool of your char. T.A.O. industries is now testing this new weapon. It comes with a IG-75 V generator in its ceramic carbonate shaft, that powers the phibranium blade. T.A.O. invented a new survival tool here. It combines a lightsource with a multiaxe tool at this stage of development. T.A.O. promises, that they are planning to add further features to the upcoming versions. 


DMG:.........15/hit
Att.Spd.:......0.8/s

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164465/1e9715267b9f4615adac8eb8ab062fa67a897ee4.png


D.I.O.S.

Digital-Information-&-Operational-System: 
In a digital environment every TRON needs a proper support. D.I.O.S. will serve this need. T.A.O. industries hooks you up with a brand new console that is providing you with plans for building structures, weapons and add-ons, interior items and structures as well as car parts and therefor replaces the former workbench.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164465/6d81d0c10c6ccbdd6cab25098a4ffaa6e6965f18.png

ITEMS
Torch.........................................+2/hit
STYX...................................... +15/hit

DMG/HP - NPC Character
Hippo.......................................-15/hit.....+ 50 HP
Bison........................................-25/hit....+ 85 HP
NPC Gunnar/Zuma...................+5/hit.....+ 25 HP
NPC Juan/Maddy.......................-8/hit......+ 5 HP
NPC Joe/Lilly.............................+1/hit.....- 10 HP

DMG - Player Character
Joe/Lilly:.....................................+2/hit
Gunnar/Zuma:............................- 5/hit
Juan/Maddy:............................no change


Furthermore we improved the the droprates of the boxes and bags in the mines.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164465/9c4afb217cb4f2af9864bd31c229877ed51864e0.png
 

TIII Backpack
*Unfortunally it doubled on players death earlier. This bug should be fixed by now.

Trees
* A bug was also fixed where trees were possibly droping armor items instead of wood planks or apples
* Trees are despawning now correctly

Districtor (item)
* We fixed a bug where players were able to build on other players building grounds


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164465/e6d83cc1cc1639eb74e026889c170deb92e20ea9.png



We do hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Latest News
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164465/699480f1f8e8c68c0d1e3906978cd0c67af32719.png
Dear TRON / Dear Gamer

It was awfully quiet around MetaTron in the last few weeks. We apologize for that and hope you will find our excuse convincing: We were working intensively on a new concept, are reassembling a new team and now work on something entirely new based on what MetaTron has shown you until now! 

As a first step, we are preparing our next, initial patch to show you a glimpse of the new direction. 
The upcoming patch comes up with new items and concentrates on the problems you have had during the night: Fighting, farming and orientation will be easier once its online. We will also fix some major bugs in balancing and prepare for new designs of major items.

Our small team hopes that this patch shows you, that we are still on track to deliver you a proper game with an even better plan for an innovative and fun gameplay! 

We wish you all the best and hope you stay tuned and (a bit) patient 

Your TubbyKiD Team

notes.title: Patch Preview
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164465/041cdc74de8b211bc3e1ada8b2b79242dca904c0.pngAfter three  content updates we will concentrate on mechanics and balancing in the upcoming patch.
In a first step we will give the NPC animals a bit more of a balance. Through you we found out that nowadays especially hippos and bisons are an unmanageable threat to some players. We will balance this out.

Furthermore we worked on the overall performance of the game for the upcoming updates.

notes.title: Patch #0.2.2.5 - MOUSE sensitivity and ITEMS ITEMS ITEMS
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164465/66f5d2bd5bc062b38f211369353e8bae6e004f94.png

New Airdrop:

The new airdrop of your company gives you an even better backpack than you can produce with your own hands! 15 slots and more robust than anything you would find on the planet. For only 7.000 XP it is the ideal companion in the wilderness Do not lose it!

New collection of items:

A total of 7 barrels await you to be discovered! Each barrel holds some storage space and a variety of color variations. Build barricades, put them in your hut or whatever else you can think of...

We also did some changes to balancing and usability. You are now able to calibrate your mouse sensitivity for example...

for more informations call our support: support@playmetatron.com

or  CLICK

notes.title: Patch #0.2.2.4 New Item and balancing updates
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164465/4d08fc11fdcde5cccc843ad5c60c848621022991.jpg

New Item - Backpack

Another new item appears in the workbench! Its a new 10 slot backpack. With it we want you to be able to have longer farming and hunting journeys in MetaTron. This item was higly requested by the community and we are happy to present it to you now!


Balancing

We made certain changes to the NPC (animal-) balancing. Especially Bison and Hippo will now be a stronger threat to you gamers out there. We raised HP and damage and lowered the drop rates a bit to improve the survival feeling for you.

more details  HERE

notes.title: Patch #0.2.2.3 PvE and privilege BUILDING
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164465/9cb5483ac5db0c5944a21f730c86fe68e0503145.png

PVE                                          

From now on we hook you up with servers especially set-up for PvE! NPCs can still harm you but other players won't. In addition, you will only be able to destroy your own buildings! 

 DISTRICTOR - Privileged Building

A new item appears in your workbench! The Districtor. Use this fine piece of engineering to set up an area where only you and/or your team are able to build houses!

For more  DETAILS

notes.title: Yes! PvE will come soon!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27164465/71a900bad1319b0e1debd33d986637552af58367.jpg

Do reviews bring any change?

Through your numerous feedback, we learned that many of you would like to have PvE servers as an additional option next to the normal PvP servers.

A new variation of MetaTron will soon be available on "PvE" marked servers! We will be looking at some great initial PvE experience with you and would like to take first steps together.

We are curious on how you like these changes and wish you a lot of fun!


Release: ASAP
